rules: Only trade when price mitigates a marked supply zone
Wait for a shooting star candle on the zone
Confirm with multi-wick rejection (multiple upper wicks stalling at the zone)
Confirm with fast MA crossing below slow MA
No trade if a high-impact news event is within 30 minutes
notes: Edit supply_zones for each symbol you trade. The bot only evaluates zones you've defined here — it does not invent them.
